##### Project general facts

Waldorf Astoria Residences Ras Al Khaimah by Al Hamra is an exclusive collection of branded residences set within the iconic Waldorf Astoria Ras Al Khaimah resort. Echoing the grandeur of classic Art Deco with intricate detailing and elegant stepped terraces, the building blends heritage with contemporary refinement. It rises above a basement level and a lobby, with a dedicated amenity floor, and offers two-, three-, four- and five-bedroom residences, including duplex and triplex penthouses.

Residents enjoy a private world of services and amenities with round-the-clock concierge and in-house PRO services. The Longevity Spa and fitness lounge includes saunas, steam rooms, treatment rooms and private studios with personal trainers. A private resident lounge, a business centre, a library, a cigar lounge, a private wine locker and cellar, a sports simulation room, a cinema lounge, the famed Starlight Terrace and a pet grooming spa complete the offer, alongside the resort's pools, kids' club, tennis courts and fine dining restaurants.

Residences feature floor-to-ceiling windows and terraces overlooking the sea and the island skyline. Custom cabinetry finished in fine wood veneers and lacquer comes with state-of-the-art integrated appliances, while bathrooms are finished in marble with premium fixtures. A smart home system with voice control manages lighting, air conditioning and curtains. Walk-in closets, ample storage, a private lobby and dedicated elevators add comfort, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamra Village is a fully integrated coastal master community in Ras Al Khaimah, set between the Hajar Mountains and the Arabian Gulf. It is home to the Al Hamra Golf Club, the Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah, Al Hamra Marina, Al Hamra Mall and a waterfront boardwalk, alongside beaches, lagoons and resorts such as The Ritz-Carlton Al Hamra Beach and Sofitel Al Hamra Beach.

Al Marjan Island and the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort lie a short drive away, and the golf club and yacht club are close to home. The centre of Ras Al Khaimah and Ras Al Khaimah International Airport are easily reached, while Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai and Dubai International Airport, with fine dining, watersports and sailing lessons available across the community.

Al Hamra Village is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious addresses in Ras Al Khaimah. Branded residences within a managed resort are in very limited supply, supporting strong demand from high-net-worth buyers and premium tenants. The rapid growth of luxury tourism around Al Marjan Island underpins long-term value for both owner-occupiers and investors.
